items.label: Which parts of the deal would a Tudor family have minded losing most?

spec.instruction: Put each card under a heading. Then choose the two cards a Tudor family would have minded losing most.

headings.label: Helped the child when he grew up

cards.label: one less mouth to feed at home
knowing when bread is baked just right
a straw mattress by the oven

teacher.where: At tables, one set between two, after slide 9 (the deal).
teacher.alsoAccept: The baking card under either heading: he learned it now, and it earned his living later. The two the family minded losing most: knowing when bread is baked just right (the trade) and one less mouth to feed.
